Ground-floor placement would directly expose the SOC to flooding risk, contradicting best practices for flood-prone regions. The SOC should be located near the main lobby or gatehouse AND must be elevated above flooding risk, a critical consideration for Philippine urban facilities. Flooding can disable critical equipment, interrupt power systems, and compromise security operations during emergencies. In flood-prone Philippine urban areas, SOC placement must prioritize elevation above expected flood levels to maintain continuous security operations during natural disasters.
